nodes.title: FlashAttention-2: Faster Attention with Better Parallelism
nodes.tldr: GPU 利用率を 2x 改善する work partitioning
nodes.abstract: Scaling Transformers to longer sequence lengths has been a major problem in the last several years, promising to improve performance in language modeling and high-resolution image understanding, as well as to unlock new applications in code, audio, and video generation. The attention layer is the main bottleneck in scaling to longer sequences, as its runtime and memory increase quadratically in the sequence length. FlashAttention-2 reduces the number of non-matmul FLOPs, parallelizes the attention computation across different thread blocks, and partitions the work between warps to reduce communication.

nodes.title: FlashAttention-3: Fast and Accurate Attention with Asynchrony
nodes.tldr: H100 の TMA/WGMMA を活用し 1.5-2x 高速化
nodes.abstract: FlashAttention-3 exploits the asynchrony of the Tensor Cores and TMA to overlap the overall computation and memory movement using warp-specialization, interleave block-wise matmul and softmax operations, and use block quantization with incoherent processing to leverage hardware support for FP8 low-precision.

nodes.title: Mamba-2: Transformers are SSMs
nodes.tldr: SSM と attention の数学的等価性を示す
nodes.abstract: While Transformers have been the main architecture behind deep learning's success in language modeling, state-space models (SSMs) such as Mamba have recently been shown to match or outperform Transformers at small to medium scale. We show that these families of models are actually quite closely related, and develop a rich framework of theoretical connections between SSMs and variants of attention, connected through various decompositions of a well-studied class of structured semiseparable matrices.
